text: An Nulaaɗo, jertiniri mofte maa ɗen lepte Alla ɗen Ñalnde Darngal, tooñirnooɓe ko'e-mun ɓen yeddu- gol Alla sirkana Mo wi'oya ontuma: Joomi amen, nennan men, nennitanaa men lepte ɗen, ruttitaa men aduna yeru dumunna hawruɗo, men gomɗine, men jokka Nulaaɓe ɓe immin-ɗaa ɓen e amen. Ɓe jaaboree feloore: E on laatanooki on woondiino ka aduna, wonnde onon on iwataa e ɗam nguurndam aduna yahon laakara, yedduɗon immital ɓaawo maayde?
